'''Racer B9G-1''' was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] that was used in droid races on the [[Promenade]] during the [[Grand Acquisitions Race]]. [[Sapaaga]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] was a frequent better on the Promenade races.
